title: What would you do in my place?
notes: The in-fiction hint (CAPTAIN.md 4.10). She never orders; she says what she would do.
The route takes the first thing that is true, in the order a new player needs it:
a dark ship, a fragment to convert, a live beacon, no probe yet, the field station
once, then her being herself. The field station's directions are the crew's own
(design/crew/field_office.txt): the electronics shop in Muldraugh, the stockroom,
The tapes come second, told once or until log one is watched: the user asked that she point players at Shepard's shelf (2026-09-28).

lines.text: Your shuttle's dark. She needs dilithium before anything else.
It turns up in open country, never in town. Your tricorder finds it.
Carry it back and load the core. Everything else waits on that.
Shepard kept a log while she was down there. Six entries, on tape.
They're on the shelf by the television in her shuttle.
She left them for whoever found the shuttle. Start with the first.
Everything I can tell you, she tells better. She was there.
You're carrying one of those recordings. Call Shepard.
She can put it on tape. In your pocket it's one bad day from lost.
One of mine is down there with a beacon running. I'd go.
Take a medkit. They're hurt, or they wouldn't be calling.
Use your sensors. A probe finds what a long walk won't.
Launch one from the shuttle and see what it brings back.
Shepard's team kept a field office in Muldraugh.
The electronics shop. The stockroom, behind the breaker box.
It's staffed. They could use the company, and so could you.
Sleep. Eat. Keep the core loaded.
That's all the wisdom this chair has, most days.
Nothing's on fire today. Take the day. I would, if I could.
Keep the beacon frequencies open. My people are still down there.
And come up for a meal now and then. Grieg cooks on Thursdays.
